George's wedding was set for early July 1893. It was the biggest royal event in Britain since the 1887 Jubilee, and the first public royal wedding in decades. "I should so much like Nicky to come, and he has never been in England. I do hope it can be arranged," George asked his grandmother.

This was true. The Shah had shouted at his servants, spat out his food, belched in public, groped women and advised Bertie (who was highly amused) to execute the Duke of Sutherland because he was too rich.
